name: Light Slate Grey
lede: Light Slate Grey is a cool, bluish grey that is a named color in CSS, with the spelling gray or grey both accepted in the web names.

sections.title: A web color
sections.body:
Our library lists Light Slate Grey as the CSS color `lightslategray`, with a blue-grey tone that matches the ISCC-NBS block called bluish gray, 6.0 units away on the CIEDE2000 scale [1]. Its hex value, #778899, is the same in every browser, so it is a fixed screen color rather than a painted one, and CSS accepts both the gray and grey spellings [1]. Paterson's dictionary lists LightSlateGray among its entries for web colors, in both the index and the grey table [2][3].

See [[slate-grey]] for the darker relative and [[grey]] for the family [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: In our archive of 23,781 paintings, a color this close appears in 408 works, or 1.7 per cent, more than 70 per cent of the named colors [4]. It peaks in the 1900s, at 29 of 1,674 paintings, 1.6 times the expected rate for the same museums [4]. These are photographs of aged, varnished paintings [4].
